source: Spec 124 R-DA (McDonald's Airtight V3): every entry is the measured PRE -> POST diff of docs/reports/golden/enrich_coa_zoning/{pre,post}/{coa,standalone}.json (Night P4 2026-10-20, lane night-p4-c, back-to-back under the dblock after the link_coa_to_parcels swap and the enrich_parcels recapture), explained from the descriptor deviation, register rule, runner code or the captures' own measured values it names. table_state was identical in all four Night P4 captures; the integrate-14 POST recapture (2026-10-20, after int12 moved the source fingerprint) reads the state the Night P4 R-CZ bracket left (table_state[].content_hash entry).

diffs.why: PIPELINE_META is derived from the descriptor and the declared check reads (Spec 122 §5.1, R-BJ): the converted step names zoning_enriched_at and the propagated columns its after_write counter checks read (coa_*_count rows); the legacy hand-written meta listed only id and lead_id although its own audit queries read the same columns.

PIPELINE_META is derived from the descriptor (Spec 122 §5.1): the declared parcels read set adds geom, the ravine / heritage lineage stamps the runner-evaluated staleness.pins read (enrich_ravines, enrich_heritage) and the propagated overlay flags (in_policy_area, on_policy_road, in_rooming_house_overlay, in_parking_zone_overlay, in_building_setback_overlay, on_priority_retail, in_queenstw_eat_overlay) the variance_context build reads; positions shift accordingly. No legacy read is dropped.

The legacy "[coa] enriched N (coverage, gaps, multi)" and "[enrich-permits] completed" lines retire with the shared enrich-permits main() (ECZ-D1, the identity split); the runner prints its target line, one start / completed line per declared phase (zoning_coa, orphan_nullify_coa, shared transaction) and the completion line. scripts/enrich-coa-zoning.descriptor.json deviations[] 2 and 3 move the column probes and the centreline recency read into the runner.
The runner titles the audit table with the descriptor identity.display_name "Enrich CoA Zoning"; the legacy literal was "CoA zoning enrichment". The consumer reads rows, not the name.

audit_table.phase follows sharing.varies_by_chain.phase, the step's 1-based coa-chain index 5, generated by scripts/generate-sharing-phase.js (LCTP-D8 / the O1 fleet standard); the legacy literal was 66 (the Spec 66 lock number).

scripts/enrich-coa-zoning.descriptor.json deviations[] 1 and the declared check set: the runner prepends coa_row_count_zero (a declared check renders on every run) and appends the inputs.expect_nonempty row (lead_parcels, parcels non-empty); enrich_coa_zoning_duration_ms is a declared check row. Every legacy row is still present.

scripts/enrich-coa-zoning.descriptor.json deviations[] 1: coa_row_count_zero is the first declared check, so every legacy row sits one position later; the metric names are otherwise the legacy names in the legacy order.

Follows the one-position shift (scripts/enrich-coa-zoning.descriptor.json deviations[] 1: position 0 is coa_row_count_zero false). Same-metric values are equal except coa_enriched_count 8746 -> 0 and coa_unlink_cleared_count 9 -> 0 on the coa invocation: Measured ordering effect, not a behaviour change: the legacy PRE coa capture was the first enrich run after link_coa_to_parcels' first converted re-match (2f0d4446: 1,931 CoAs back-filled, 226 pairs retracted) and the enrich_parcels --full recapture, so the legacy run applied the catch-up (8,746 rows refreshed, 9 orphans cleared); the converted POST then ran on that settled state and wrote 0. Both read the same fixed point: table_state coa_applications 33966/a140d3ef is identical in PRE coa, PRE standalone, POST coa and POST standalone, the legacy PRE standalone run also wrote 0 (coa_enriched_count 0, coa_unlink_cleared_count 0), and the converted R-EX rerun proof read zero writes (strict). Night 1 recapture 2026-10-21 (REFREEZE-BUNDLE-1 split by R-II; public re-acquisition per operator CHAT-28; Spec 124 R-DA): INPUT DRIFT traced to coa's source drift and link_coa_to_parcels' new links: coa_enriched_count 0 -> 111 (the new and re-linked CoAs), coa_with_lot_confidence/ravine_distance 31762 -> 31769, the per-attribute counts +1..+7, zoning coverage 90.6 -> 90.5, so records_total/updated, the lead_parcels row_count and content_hash move. NOT CODE: the night's runtime edits are runLinkPhase extra_counters (R-IG; this step declares none, so no key and no behaviour change, lock type-counters T6) and descriptor/notes/guard text that no runner reads at run time; they move lib_fingerprint (fef97e27 -> 93b059a9) and source_fingerprint, not this output.

Follows the one-position shift (an INFO counter now sits where the PASS coverage row was, and vice versa); and the two null-share rows coa_bylaw_max_fsi_null_pct / coa_bylaw_max_coverage_pct_null_pct are declared checks with a bound (pct <= 97, pct <= 66), so they render PASS where the legacy printed INFO beside its own "<= x%" text. Verdict PASS in both.

The library renders the declared limit in force ("viol == 0", "pct >= 83", "pct <= 97", "pct <= 66") where the legacy rows carried no threshold field (only the two null-share rows had a "<= x%" text); the bounds are the step-owned variables in summary.records_meta.config.

coa_zoning_class_coverage_pct carries its declared limit (pct >= 83, severity FAIL) and its declared warn limit (pct >= 80), which the library renders as threshold and warn_threshold; the legacy coverage row had no rendered bound.
The library stamps every declared check row with source "check" (verdict.js checkRow); the legacy hand-built rows carried no source field.
The library stamps every declared check row with observed before_write / after_write (FLEET-2 lib #52); the legacy rows had no such field.
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the row-derived failed-check count (0).
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the row-derived check tally ("all").
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the row-derived warned-check count (0).

Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the resolved step-owned logic variables in force (the enrich_coa_zoning_* coverage and null-share bounds); the legacy read enrich-permits' shared variables.
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run (FLEET-2 lib #75): records_meta.errors is always emitted, [] when no FAIL row.
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run (FLEET-2 lib #75): records_meta.warnings is always emitted, [] when no WARN row.
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: who owns the pipeline_runs row (chain_owned under --chain=coa, owned standalone, Spec 122 §5.1).
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the pool error counter the library records on every run (0).

The descriptor emits key target ("coa"), the shared lead-zoning module's bound target (scripts/lib/compute/enrich-coa-zoning.js forTarget('coa')), which replaces the retired ENRICH_TARGET selector (ECZ-D1).
Runner meta key stamped by scripts/lib/step on every converted run: the declared terminal the run landed (enriched); the legacy had no terminal vocabulary.

Spec 124 R-DQ (124a:479: "the R-AS instrument restores only the column it perturbed. So a column the step writes while healing keeps its new value"): the POST captures were retaken at integrate-14 because int12's V3 condition-9 backfill re-cited deviations[].adjudicated_by in this descriptor, a computeSourceFingerprint input (#44 STALE).
